description:
Cast Horned Kavu by paying {2}.
Horned Kavu enters the battlefield, triggering itself and Wild Pair.
Resolve the Horned Kavu trigger, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the Wild Pair trigger, searching your library for Endurance and putting it onto the battlefield.
Endurance enters the battlefield, causing you to put all cards from your graveyard on the bottom of your library.
Activate Thermopod's second ability by sacrificing Endurance, adding {R}.
Endurance dies, triggering Luminous Broodmoth, returning Endurance from your graveyard to the battlefield with a flying counter on it.
Endurance enters the battlefield, triggering its ability.
Holding priority, activate Thermopod's second ability by sacrificing Endurance, adding {R}.
Resolve the Endurance trigger, causing you to put all cards from your graveyard on the bottom of your library.
Repeat.
